items.title: Generative AI in Financial Services: A Field Experiment in Insurance Advisory
items.claim: AI advice increases insurance premiums by 28 percent within fifteen days for non-pilot brokers.

items.title: FinVeriQA: Financial Research Agents for Question Answering: Routing, Retrieval, MCP Tool Use, and Provenance-Aware Evidence Verification
items.claim: Independent verification beats shared-evidence checks when financial evidence is corrupted.

items.title: An AI-Powered Multiverse Analysis of Empirical Finance Research: Evidence from Reused Natural Experiments
items.claim: Regression discontinuity claims survive more specification changes than difference-in-differences claims.

items.title: Evaluating LLM-Assisted Retail Trading Decisions: Design and Operational Validation of the FACET Frozen-Case Framework
items.claim: Decision quality can be audited by freezing assisted cases before execution.

items.title: Unevaluable Alpha: A Reporting Standard for AI Performance Claims in Asset Management
items.claim: No accepted methodology lets managers substantiate AI return-improvement claims even if real.

items.title: A Capability Framework for Evaluating Agentic AI Platforms in Regulated Enterprises
items.claim: Demonstration-based platform scoring measures presentation as much as capability because of halo effects.
